label: SALT published summary-allowed warm-up, constrained communication

deviations.description: Two independent development dyads per recipe, rather than the paper's 50 trajectories; fixed by V3 campaign.

Use the reference campaign's gpt-5.6-luna/high configuration; the paper's warm-up ablation was reported for Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite and Gemini-3.7-Flash. This is a model extension, not replication of those warm-up estimates.

Only the execution owner supplies isolated task execution, official endpoint routing, accounting, and frozen release settings. Its declared changes must be recorded before dispatch; recipe tests are not live engine validation.
